title: Value-Savvy Explorer
description: Price-aware but curious; buys on design, coolness, diet & nutrition and eco credentials. Ignores medical claims, seasons, trends and mood.

title: Premium Wellness Enthusiast
description: Not price-sensitive; every signal counts, especially medical/functional claims, seasonality, trends and mood. High-engagement, high-basket.

title: Seasonal Mood Shopper
description: Price-aware and driven by moment and mood; follows trends, seasons and eco cues. Not swayed by health claims, design or novelty.
